'''''The Princess and the Scoundrel''''' is a [[canon]] novel written by [[Beth Revis]] set shortly after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] that features the [[wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa]] and the [[Marriage|couple's]] honeymoon aboard the ''[[Halcyon]]'' [[Star Cruiser]]. It was published by [[Del Rey]] on [[August 16]], [[2022]].
